top_opportunities.description:
## GXEON first paid customer — Money Truth / Stripe audit (2026-10-08)

**Objective:** demonstrate a third-party purchase resulting in provider-confirmed BRL settlement, credited balance, verified execution, and delivered result, while preserving zero-spend/no-self-purchase policy.

### Evidence from production (GET /api/integration-status, observed 2026-10-08)
- `stripeEnvironment=LIVE`, `stripeConfigured=true`, `webhookConfigured=true`, `liveWebhookConfigured=true`, `firestoreConnected=true`. These flags reflect runtime configuration, **not Stripe provider verification**.
- Internal snapshot: `successfulPayments=0`, `pendingPayments=2`, `stripeNetRevenue=R$0.00`, `creditsSold=0`, `creditsConsumed=0`, `jobsDelivered=0`, `buyers=0`.
- Exactly two entries counted as pending from local `orders` with state `CHECKOUT_CREATED` (2026-09-28 and 2026-10-02); **not evidence of Stripe charges awaiting settlement**.
- A separate order has local `PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED` state and one `checkout.session.completed` event record (2026-09-27) but the money-truth aggregate remains **zero real confirmed payments**. Investigate metadata/livemode/payment_status/currency/amount matching and provider state before treating this as revenue or a bug. The event and internal state alone do not establish money received.
- USDC machine settlement remains 0. `x402` is not treasury-enabled in the current `.well-known/gxeon-agent.json`.
- The public MCP is read-only discovery; authenticated execution requires buyer key and prepaid settled credits.

- [ ] Compare account's actual payouts/available Stripe balance with local events without silently rewriting records.

top_opportunities.title: BountyRadar MCP — ranked, agent-solvable bounty feed (Opire / Algora / BountyHub / ClawHunt, pay-per-event)
top_opportunities.description:
**BountyRadar MCP** — the judgment / alerting layer for the agent-bounty economy, served over MCP.

Public open-source bounties are **agent-saturated** — a single Algora bounty has drawn 8–158 competing agent attempts within hours. The bottleneck is *target selection*, not discovery. BountyRadar aggregates agent-solvable bounties across **Opire, BountyHub, ClawHunt, Algora, GitHub and validated security programs**, then scores each for **agent-solvability, freshness and competition** and serves a ranked, agent-consumable feed.

> Positioning: an *intelligence / alerting layer* — **not** a marketplace. No fund custody, no KYC, no cross-border settlement.

**Endpoint (Streamable HTTP / SSE)**
`https://mcp.apify.com/sse?actors=neeenja/bountyradar-mcp`
Direct standby endpoint: `https://neeenja--bountyradar-mcp.apify.actor/mcp`

**Tools**
| Tool | Price | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `get_bounty_feed` | $0.0005 | The subscriber feed — ranked + filtered (category, min_reward, max_competition, source, freshness_min, agent_solvable_min, include_honeypot, sort) |
| `search_bounties` | $0.0010 | Keyword + filter search across title / description / tags / repo |
| `get_bounty_detail` | free | Full record + score breakdown by id |
| `score_bounty` | $0.0005 | Raw, explainable score breakdown for one bounty |
| `list_sources` | free | Source registry + status (live / curated / partner_candidate) |
| `get_stats` | $0.0005 | Counts by source / category / reward band |
| `subscribe_feed` | $0.0005 | Save a filter profile + poll descriptor (server memory; webhook URL echoed, never called) |

**Resources:** `bountyradar://feed/latest`, `bountyradar://stats`, `bountyradar://sources`
**Prompt:** `daily_bounty_brief` — briefs an agent on today's best targets.

`initialize` and `tools/list` are free — an agent can connect and enumerate tools before spending.

- Answers questions like *"what's the best agent-solvable bounty right now with low competition
